name: Solar Visibility & Surface Survey Clarity
earthLandingPolicy: Earth reuses the inherited atmospheric-rocky descent/touchdown/on-foot/takeoff lifecycle through the surface-support layer; the canonical SOL Earth body flags and physical state are not rewritten.
earthSurfacePolicy: Local Earth terrain is deterministic terrestrial presentation, not mapped geography/topography. Ground color/relief and ordinary fog are lightweight proxies; ecology, hydrology, clouds and global weather are deferred.
earthAtmospherePolicy: Surface sky uses the existing wavelength-dependent atmospheric-optics model driven by the SOL 101325 Pa reference atmosphere, real surface gravity, live Sun altitude/eclipses and shared celestial observer geometry.
earthAlbedoPolicy: The CC BY 4.0 Akshat Earth albedo remains lazy-loaded and is explicitly mapped north-up with glTF V orientation handled at the texture level. The supplied GLB geometry is not used.
flightNavigationPolicy: Newtonian gravity/integrator, ship dynamics, flight computer, FRAME/transit, SOL states, astronomical observer/eclipses, planetary rotation, landing transition and takeoff/orbit insertion remain inherited rather than redesigned.
mobileCachePolicy: All changed/reachable versioned module edges are stamped ue0105f for Safari/GitHub Pages cache isolation.
scope: SOL Sun photosphere presentation, landed/surface Sun visibility display mapping, and survey-beacon clarity only; no celestial geometry, atmosphere physics, landing physics, orbital dynamics or SKY SPAWN changes.
sunVisualPolicy: The user-supplied CC BY 4.0 Sketchfab Sun asset supplies its embedded 1024x512 photosphere image, converted to a neutral luminance-detail map so runtime stellar/atmospheric color controls hue, on the existing SOL Sun sphere. The supplied GLB geometry/transmission shell is not shipped or loaded at runtime.
surfaceSunPolicy: Live surface-Sun direction, altitude, angular radius, eclipse visibility and atmospheric spectral color remain authoritative. Only display opacity uses bounded HDR compression so physical extinction is not incorrectly interpreted as alpha against a bright daytime sky.
surfaceSurveyMarkerPolicy: Existing procedural POI beacons retain their geometry and scan behavior but now carry an explicit SURVEY / SCAN label with the POI name.
